entries.answer: We currently offer two courses: Mithila Painting (4 months, traditional techniques and natural colors) and Cutting & Stitching (4 months per batch, practical tailoring skills). See the Courses page for current batch status and admissions.

keywords: when does the next batch start
entries.answer: To join a course, visit our center in Benipatti, Madhubani to collect the physical admission form. Bring 2 passport-size photos and a copy of your Aadhaar card. Check the Admission page for which batches are currently open.

Our courses are free to attend. There is a one-time ₹500 admission fee collected at enrollment, meant as a commitment deposit rather than tuition. If you have questions about refund eligibility, please ask us directly via the Contact page — we want to give you an accurate answer rather than guess.

Mithila KritiKala is a registered public charitable trust with 12A and 80G registration from the Income Tax Department, and is listed on the NGO Darpan portal (NITI Aayog). Full registration numbers and certificates are on our Transparency page.
You can donate securely via Razorpay from our Donate page. Donations qualify for an 80G tax deduction under Indian tax law. CSR-1 registration is currently in progress.
You can reach us at contact@mithilakritikala.com or +91 7903120432. We're located on Kataiya Road, Benipatti, Madhubani, Bihar. Use the Contact page for a message form and map.
We welcome volunteers as Art Teachers, Stitching Trainers, Digital Marketing help, Photographers/Videographers, and for Fundraising & Outreach. Apply through the Join Us page.

Mithila KritiKala was founded on July 18, 2025 in Madhubani, Bihar by Vishal Kumar Thakur, to preserve the art of Mithila painting while giving rural women a path to financial independence. Read the full story on the About Us page.
So far we've trained 20+ women across our two courses, reaching 1 district (Madhubani) since our founding in July 2025.
